name: Bicho Cidrão
body:
Bicho Cidrão CR
1

A transparent specter stands before you dressed in the phantom peasant garb of a shepherd, holding a glowing ghostly crook.

XP 400
LN Medium undead (incorporeal)
Init +1; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 12, touch 12, flat-footed 11 (+1 Dex, +1 deflection)
hp 11 (2d8+2)
Fort +1, Ref +1, Will +4
Defensive Abilities incorporeal; Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 0 ft., fly 30 ft. (perfect)
Melee incorporeal touch +1 (1d8)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks horrid wail (DC 14), invisibility

STATISTICS

Str -, Dex 13, Con -, Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 12
Base Atk +0; CMB +0; CMD 11
Feats Ability Focus (horrid wail)
Skills Fly +9, Handle Animal +3, Intimidate +6, Perception +6, Stealth +6
Languages Common
SQ good shepherd

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Good Shepherd (Su)

The bicho cidrão can communicate with goats and sheep, as though continuously under the effects of the spell speak with animals. It can influence goats and sheep as per the druid ability wild empathy, using its HD as its druid level with a +4 racial modifier (total modifier +7).

Invisibility (Su)

The bicho cidrão can turn invisible at will, as the spell invisibility.

Horrid Wail (Su)

The bicho cidrão can emit a terrible keening. All living creatures within a 30-foot spread, other than sheep or goats, must succeed on a DC 14 Will save or become panicked for 2d4 rounds. This is a sonic mind-affecting fear effect. A creature that successfully saves against the wail cannot be affected by the same bicho cidrão’s wail for 24 hours. The save DC is Charisma-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any mountains or plains
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

The bicho cidrão is the tormented soul of a shepherd. The specifics behind the shepherd’s death determine the habits of the bicho cidrão it spawns. Some die in defense of their flock, and in death are unable or unwilling to divest themselves of their duty. Others die in acts of cowardice, attempting to flee danger only to die anyway, and the resulting bicho cidrão lingers in an attempt to find redemption for its craven actions.

Unlike most undead, the bicho cidrão is not overtly hostile to the living. They will not knowingly take any action likely to result in harm or death to any sheep or goats. The presence of a bicho cidrão can be a blessing to herders, as its presence protects their flocks. However, the obsessive attention of the creature can cause frustration and confusion for them as well, as it has no regard for any humanoids tending the flocks, only the animals it is obsessed with protecting. A humanoid attempting to halt or subvert a bicho cidrão’s plans to protect a herd are likely to be considered an enemy and provoke a hostile response, even if they their actions are meant to be in the flock’s best interests.

The bicho cidrão’s presence causes clouds to gather and rain to fall within 2 miles of its location. Unseasonal or prolonged wet weather in an area is a strong sign that a bicho cidrão is haunting the region.
